name: Claude Plugin Ecosystem Hub
headline: claude hub: explore AI extensions
short_description: The Claude Plugin Ecosystem Hub is a comprehensive index of over 500 Claude AI extensions, including plugins, skills, MCPs, commands, agents, and marketplaces. It benefits developers and operations teams by providing a centralized directory to discover and integrate AI capabilities. The hub connects to various AI workflows and tools, streamlining the process of enhancing Claude AI's functionality.
author: pluginagentmarketplace

sections.overview:
The Claude Plugin Ecosystem Hub is a curated directory of over 10,000 MCP servers and 500+ plugins, skills, commands, agents, and marketplace resources for Claude AI. It provides developers, teams, and enterprises a centralized source to discover, evaluate, and install extensions that enhance Claude's functionality across various use cases. The hub includes verified listings from multiple plugin marketplaces, GitHub-based collections, and official resources, with security considerations and active maintenance tracked. Users can browse categorized resources by type—from plugin marketplaces and MCP servers to enterprise solutions and academic resources—streamlining the process of finding and integrating the right tools for their Claude workflows.
Discovering and evaluating Claude plugins and MCP servers for specific development tasks
Finding enterprise-grade agents and multi-agent orchestration frameworks
Locating community-maintained skills and slash commands for specialized workflows
Researching security practices and best practices for MCP server integration
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/pluginagentmarketplace/claude-plugin-ecosystem-hub`
sections.usage:
```
Search the Claude Plugin Ecosystem Hub for [PLUGIN_TYPE] related to [INDUSTRY]. Provide a list of the top 5 most relevant plugins, including their names, descriptions, and installation instructions.
```
Copy

```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
```
